## Invitations

A total of 394 people were invited to the River Districts outreach activity. Attendance was 49, representing a rate of 12.4 per cent. The attendance figure provides a straightforward measure of participation among those invited and will support review of future outreach arrangements.

Van days were maintained where roads allowed. This helped preserve access for communities affected by local road conditions and supported delivery of the planned activity. Outreach arrangements should continue to reflect the practical access available in each area.

## Contact

Of the invitations issued, 350 were sent with an SMS. A further 350 people received a reminder message. The use of SMS contact and reminder messages provided two opportunities to communicate with invitees and support attendance.

The contact approach should be considered alongside the attendance result when planning subsequent activity. Maintaining clear records of invitations, attendance, and follow-up contact will assist with monitoring and reporting.

Prepared by G. Evans.
